events.description:
The event will be followed by three rounds for the participants.

Round 1: Group Discussion
This round is a discussion round that tests leadership skills, communication skills, teamwork, listening ability, general awareness, and problem-solving skills. Participants will be divided into different groups and a GD topic will be assigned, wherein 10 minutes would be allotted to each group to discuss the topic. The more composed and articulate individuals will qualify for the next round.

Round 2: Mock Interview
The mock interview round tests an individual’s fitness in the corporate world. This is going to be an HR round of interview, wherein the participant will be judged on their communication skills, perseverance skills, persuasion skills and listening skills.

Round 3: Corporate Strategy and Risk Management
1. A critical corporate scenario with reference to personnel management will be given and the participant will have to explain their strategy within 10 minutes.
2. Evaluation will be done on the basis of articulation, fluency, clarity of thought, creativity, presence of mind and practical applicability and relevance of the solution.

events.description:
Pitchers comprises an offline quiz based on the theme “Startups and Entrepreneurship” (qualifying in nature), followed by a startup-idea pitch for qualifying teams.

Round 1: Offline Quiz
An offline quiz based on the theme “Startups and Entrepreneurship” (qualifying in nature).
a. 40 multiple choice questions with one or more than one correct answer.
b. There is no negative marking.
c. The qualifying score is 30%.

Round 2: Startup Pitch
Qualifiers of Round 1 will be required to present their startup idea using a PowerPoint presentation (not exceeding 10 slides excluding cover and Thank You slides).
The presentation must address the following questions:
a. What motivated you to take up this startup idea?
b. Why do you think you will succeed in the chosen industry?
c. Explain your revenue generation strategy.
d. Explain your Marketing and Finance strategy.

events.description:
The event will be followed by three rounds for the participants.

Round 1: Brain Teaser (Elimination Round)
A quiz link related to advertisements will be provided. Each member of the team has to take the test individually, and then their results will be clubbed together for final evaluation. The time limit for the quiz is 15 minutes and the total number of questions is 20. (Please ensure good internet connectivity.)

Round 2: Evolution (30 minutes) (Elimination Round – 5 teams will be shortlisted)
A video advertisement will be shown. Participants will be given 20 minutes to write their analysis of the advertisement on an A4 sheet of paper.

Round 3: Thinkistaan
1. Advertisement of a given product.
2. You will have full liberty to choose the platform of advertisement and how to create it.
3. The minimum time limit for the advertisement is 1.5 minutes.
4. The maximum time limit for the advertisement is 3 minutes.
5. Q&A round.

The advertisement must be at least 1.5 minutes and no longer than 3 minutes, followed by a Q&A round.
